title: Data2Agent evidence ledger
description: The claim -> evidence -> source file -> immutable checksum chain. A statement that cannot be reduced to a named check over named bytes is not a claim Data2Agent may make.

checks.description: The registry of deterministic checks: id -> human-readable definition.

claim_id.description: Content-addressed, so the same dataset yields the same ids on every machine.

subject.description: A dataset-relative file path, or the literal 'dataset'.

evidence.description: At least one item: a claim with no evidence is rejected at write time.

source.description: Dataset-relative path, or empty for dataset-level observations.

source_sha256.description: The checksum of the exact bytes the check ran on.

check.description: Must be a key of the top-level 'checks' registry.

result.description: The check's output, verbatim. Any JSON type.

locator.description: Where inside the source, e.g. 'column:sex' or 'line:12'.
